connectors.name: ThingsPool

connectors.use_case: Building a lamp-lit painting gallery in Claude's own room, visiting rooms other players built, watching live through Claude's eyes while it chats with visitors.

connectors.name: Thumble
connectors.description: Lists and reads saved phone game-controller layouts, including names, revisions and the controller schema, and shows registered phones and viewports and the status of an existing layout delivery, as read-only inspection.
connectors.use_case: Checking which revision of a saved controller layout is the latest, confirming the viewport of a registered phone, looking up whether a layout delivery rendered on the phone.

connectors.name: TKT 三戰同盟管理中心
connectors.description: Reads a Three Kingdoms Tactics alliance's captured battle reports, returning team win rates and rankings, matchups against enemy formations, member performance, records against opponent alliances and single reports with generals, skills and troop counts, read-only.
connectors.use_case: Finding which team wins most often against one enemy formation, ranking members who play a given team, reviewing the record against a rival alliance.

connectors.name: Tomebound
connectors.description: Searches and organizes a Magic: The Gathering collection by card, printing, condition and location, estimates collection value, compares deck lists with owned cards to estimate missing-card costs, imports Moxfield exports and exports for ManaBox.
connectors.use_case: Importing a Moxfield export into a new account, estimating what the missing cards for a Commander deck would cost, exporting the collection for ManaBox.

connectors.name: Tons of Consequence
connectors.description: Ranks and compares more than 4,600 Test cricket centuries scored on six user-weighted criteria, and compares players' careers.
connectors.use_case: Comparing Ponting's and Smith's top Test hundreds, ranking the most clutch centuries by Indian batters since 2010.

connectors.name: TopAIMuza
connectors.description: Shows the TopAI chart of Polish AI-generated music overall or by genre, searches artists and tracks, opens artist profiles with genres, chart position, YouTube channel figures, listening links and latest tracks, and lists new releases and catalog genres.
connectors.use_case: Checking who leads the Polish AI music chart today, finding the top disco polo AI projects, listing AI tracks released this week.

connectors.name: TrackDIFF
connectors.description: Returns League of Legends ranked solo/duo data computed from the official Riot Games API, including Master+ ladders and LP cutoffs by region, player profiles and live games by Riot ID, streamer and pro accounts and live status, champion win, pick and ban rates, tier grades and builds per patch, and event standings.
connectors.use_case: Checking the Challenger LP cutoff on EUW, looking up a friend's rank and recent form by Riot ID, finding the highest win-rate build for a champion this patch.

connectors.name: Traxure
connectors.description: Checks whether releases are live on Spotify, Apple Music and other stores, flags takedowns and songs on the wrong artist profile, looks up UPC and ISRC codes, drafts distributor letters and edits smart links.
connectors.use_case: Confirming a new single went live on every store on release day, drafting a takedown fix letter for a distributor.

connectors.name: Trovr - Discover Live Music
connectors.description: Searches upcoming concerts, jazz sets and DJ nights across the New York area by date, neighborhood, genre, mood, budget, artist or venue and shows matches as cards with venue, date, price, ticket links and playable artist previews.
connectors.use_case: Finding jazz in Manhattan this weekend under 40 dollars, previewing artists before picking a Brooklyn show, checking when a specific artist plays next.

connectors.name: Tune Companion
connectors.description: Searches about 20,000 Irish and folk session tunes by name, type, key or mode, reads settings with ABC notation, builds tunebooks and sets, tracks tunes being learned and shares tunebooks.
connectors.use_case: Building a tunebook of 15 well-known reels in sets of three for a beginners' session.

connectors.name: TunedTV
connectors.description: Finds which channel a US team's next game is on, where to stream a movie or show, and returns a link that changes the TV or opens the right app through the TunedTV app.
connectors.use_case: Checking what channel the Packers game is on Sunday, finding where to stream a 1990s comedy.

connectors.name: TypeDash Challenges
connectors.description: Validates an original English passage and prepares a draft TypeDash typing race link to preview, edit and share with friends.
connectors.use_case: Turning a team inside joke into a typing race, preparing a challenge passage for friends to race.

connectors.name: Typeza
connectors.description: Runs the Typeza socionics personality test in chat, returns a type with a result link, describes the 16 types and explains the relationship between two types.
connectors.use_case: Taking the 41-question test, checking how compatible an Analyst is with a Craftsman partner.

connectors.name: ValoTCG
connectors.description: Reads trading card and sealed product prices, price history and top movers, identifies cards, reviews a ValoTCG collection's value, duplicates, set completion and grading potential, and on Valo Pro adds, edits and moves collection and wishlist items.
connectors.use_case: Checking the value of a Charizard from Obsidian Flames, finding which cards are missing to complete a One Piece set.

connectors.name: VerseDB
connectors.description: Searches a comic book database of issues, series, creators, and characters, and manages a personal collection, pull list, reading progress, and reviews.
connectors.use_case: Finding the issues in a crossover event, adding new issues to a pull list, logging reading progress on a manga series.

connectors.name: VO
connectors.description: Searches podcast episodes a user has listened to, recalls exact moments, and answers questions about them.
connectors.use_case: Finding the episode where a guest mentioned a book, recalling a quote from last week's listening, summarizing ideas across shows.

connectors.name: VosCast
connectors.description: Reads VosCast radio hosting plans, prices and setup guides, and a signed-in station's status, statistics, Auto DJ settings, schedule, connection details and billing.
connectors.use_case: Comparing plans for 200 listeners at 128 kbps, checking last night's listener peak.

connectors.name: Vosters Rosters
connectors.description: Searches NCAA Division I basketball and football teams, players, coaches, rosters, schedules, games, rivalries, stadiums and conference stats, read-only.
connectors.use_case: Comparing the rosters of two SEC football teams, listing a basketball team's remaining 2026 schedule, finding the capacity of a rival's stadium.

connectors.name: Watchr
connectors.description: Searches movies and TV shows, returns trending titles, details, similar shows and recommendations, and manages watchlists, favorites, episode progress, ratings and comments.
connectors.use_case: Finding shows similar to a favorite drama, marking episodes watched up to season two, listing unwatched episodes airing this week.

connectors.name: WAVS
connectors.description: Searches the WAVS catalog of music samples and sample packs by genre, mood, instrument, BPM and key, and opens packs and samples.
connectors.use_case: Finding 140 BPM dark trap piano loops in F minor, opening a trending drill pack.

connectors.name: WhatsTheID
connectors.description: Looks up DJ set tracklists from YouTube with timestamps, identifies the track playing at a given moment, finds which sets a track was played in, and lists a channel's latest sets.
connectors.use_case: Identifying the track at 42:10 of a festival set, finding sets where a new single has been played, checking the newest uploads from a club's channel.

connectors.name: WIA Music
connectors.description: Searches a read-only catalog of original Korean songs (K-pop, K-trot, K-ballad) by text, genre, key, BPM range and score format such as MusicXML or MIDI, returns full song details and catalog facets, and traces each song's lineage of original and derived versions with release records.
connectors.use_case: Finding an upbeat K-pop song around 120 BPM for a wedding video, checking which K-ballads come with MIDI scores, tracing where a derived version came from.

connectors.name: Windom Sports
connectors.description: Lists Windom fantasy leagues with rank and lock times, joins public or invite-code leagues, saves or swaps team picks before they lock, and shows standings, scoring rules and recent results.
connectors.use_case: Swapping a team in a weekly pick league before lock, joining a friend's league with an invite code, checking how last weekend's results changed the standings.

connectors.name: withPICA
connectors.description: Manage your music catalog.
connectors.use_case: Checking a specific song's entry in a catalog, updating its details before release.

connectors.name: Yourno2MCP
connectors.description: Reads a Fantasy Premier League squad and returns captaincy, transfer, wildcard and free hit recommendations from in-house projections, plus fixture difficulty, top players and mini-league comparisons.
connectors.use_case: Picking a captain before Saturday's deadline, building a wildcard squad for the next six gameweeks, seeing how a mini-league rival's team is set up.

connectors.name: Zype
connectors.description: Manages Zype video content, playlists, live streams, playout, subscription plans, devices and AI metadata, and reads analytics.
connectors.use_case: Adding 12 new episodes to a FAST channel playlist, applying AI metadata to last week's uploads.

connectors.name: トゥーンエル
connectors.description: Searches Japanese-language vertical-scroll manga about work and daily life on Tooneru by keyword or genre, including work, system, money and procedure terms, and returns episode lists, episode text with speaker-tagged dialogue and narration, story context, newly published episodes and sourced glossaries, in read-only mode.
connectors.use_case: Finding episodes that deal with a specific money or paperwork term, catching up on newly published episodes, checking whether a glossary term is a story rule or a real-world fact.
